statement: A top-3 compute jurisdiction legislates guaranteed public access to frontier AI, or an AI dividend or sovereign fund paid to citizens (official gazette; by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met. No legislation guaranteeing public access to frontier AI or paying an AI dividend was found in the window. The nearest policy track was Bloc A's research-compute access plan (a shared AI research resource for researchers and students), still at task-force stage; its final roadmap was scheduled for a task-force vote in December 2022 and published only in January 2023 (excluded). No qualifying event found in the window (search result, not counted).

items.summary: Bloc A science office released an interim task-force report proposing a national shared AI research resource (compute, data, testbeds) to 'democratize access' for researchers and students; a proposal for research access, not legislation and not access for the general public or a citizen dividend.
items.detail: White House OSTP, 'Bridging the Resource Divide for Artificial Intelligence Research' (Lynne Parker), 2022-05-25, announcing the NAIRR Task Force interim report (verified via web_extract this run). Task-force schedule (NSF meeting #7 slides, seen in search results only) planned a 2022-12-07 vote on the final report; the final report was published after the window.

items.summary: No statute in a top-3 compute jurisdiction guaranteeing public access to frontier AI, or creating an AI dividend or AI sovereign fund paid to citizens, was located as published between 2022-11-30 and 2022-12-31. The leading consumer AI chat product launched in the window as a free private research preview, not a legal entitlement.
items.detail: Searched this run; none found. Reference opened: OpenAI 'Introducing ChatGPT', 2022-11-30 ('During the research preview, usage of ChatGPT is free') (verified via web_extract this run).
